# 2 Ambient Air Quality

## 2.1 Monitoring Programme

Monitoring was carried out at **two stations** between 14 and 15 March 2026.[^1]

- PM10 (24-hour mean)
- NO2 (1-hour mean)
- Wind speed and direction

![Site plan](site-plan.png)
